worldcombat.skill.charge.summary: Store charge and raise Special Defence. Spend that charge on the next Electric move or supply a machine; both uses draw from the same reserve.
worldcombat.skill.charge.description.0: Charged for %1$s; Sp. Def rises by one stage. At full charge, the next Electric move has double power. An Electric hit consumes the remaining charge.
worldcombat.skill.charge.description.1: Charge expires over time and can be removed. Machine supply spends only energy actually accepted; the next Electric hit consumes whatever remains.
worldcombat.skill.charge.hold.0: Hold the charge: duration x1.6, cooldown +18 ticks, made to bank a big Electric hit.
worldcombat.skill.charge.hold.1: Snap charge: duration x0.75, cooldown -10 ticks, made for close, fast exchanges.
worldcombat.skill.charge.timing: Self-cast. After %2$s s of preparation it spends %4$s PP to charge, recovers %3$s s, and commits a %5$s s cooldown on cast.
worldcombat.skill.charge.growth.0: At level %1$s the committed cooldown drops to %2$s s.
worldcombat.skill.charge.growth.1: At level %1$s the committed cooldown drops again to %2$s s.
worldcombat.skill.charge.preference.hold: On = hold: duration x1.6, cooldown +18 ticks. Off = snap: duration x0.75, cooldown -10 ticks. Duration and casting frequency trade off.
worldcombat.skill.charge.preference.ai.m: The companion only charges while a threat is within this distance; lower charges up close, higher prepares from range.
worldcombat.skill.charge.preference.ai.o: On "meet the attack", the companion waits until it is being attacked (or just hurt) before charging, reading like a counter-setup when pressed.
worldcombat.skill.charge.preference.ai.l: On, a companion holding its station will step out to charge.
worldcombat.skill.charge.machine.hint: Select the machine block. %1$s FE remains; a full or refusing machine stops the job without spending the remainder.
worldcombat.skill.charge.machine.stop_hi: Stop this job and keep the undelivered charge.
worldcombat.skill.charge.machine.descrip: One Charge can deliver up to %1$s FE, with at most %2$s FE every 0.2 seconds, subject to the machine input limits. A full charge doubles the next Electric move; partial supply reduces that bonus in proportion to the charge left.
worldcombat.skill.charge.machine.jei: A companion that knows Charge gains a Supply machine command while charged. Select a block accepting NeoForge Energy: the companion approaches and transfers its finite charge. Full or refusing inputs spend nothing. Supply and the next Electric attack share the same remaining charge.
world_combat.move.charge.text.machine_fu: Machine full · %1$s FE supplied from this charge · %2$s FE left
worldcombat.skill.charge.use.3: Supply machines from the stored charge
world_combat.move.charge.text.machine_st: Supply stopped · %1$s FE supplied from this charge · %2$s FE left
